title: G8 · 拒绝
body: I targeted the largest reliable headroom with bounded-range two-sum counting and a compact wheel-6 prime sieve, while adding low-risk allocation and dispatch improvements to topK, word-frequency selection, and matMul. The unchanged fallback paths preserve behavior on sparse, wide, fractional, and large-range inputs, and the conservative task-ratio projection is about a 9% geomean lift, enough to clear the 5% acceptance bar.
